test_title: PYST 54: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the correctly spelled sentence.

options.text: The gardener planted colourfull flowers in the gardin.
The gardner planted colorful flowers in the gardin.
The gardener planted colourful flowers in the garden.
The gardner planted colorfull flowers in the garden.

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"gardener"** refers to a person who is involved in gardening, taking care of plants, flowers, and landscapes. (माली) • **Example:** The gardener waters the plants every morning to keep them healthy. • The word **"colourful"** (British English spelling) means full of bright colors or having a variety of colors. (रंगीन) • **Example:** The artist created a colourful painting that captivated everyone. • The word **"garden"** refers to a piece of ground, often near a house, where flowers, plants, and vegetables are grown. (बगीचा) • **Example:** The children played happily in the beautiful garden filled with flowers. • Hence, the correctly spelled sentence is: "The gardener planted colourful flowers in the garden." Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1:** The sentence contains two incorrect spellings: "colourfull" should be "colourful" and "gardin" should be "garden". (गलत वर्तनी) • **Hindi Meaning:** रंगीन फूलों को बगीचे में लगाया। • **Example:** Incorrect: The gardener planted colourfull flowers in the gardin. • **Option 2:** The word "gardner" is misspelled; it should be "gardener", and "gardin" should be "garden". (गलत वर्तनी) • **Hindi Meaning:** माली ने रंगीन फूलों को बगीचे में लगाया। • **Example:** Incorrect: The gardner planted colorful flowers in the gardin. • **Option 4:** The word "gardner" is misspelled; it should be "gardener", and "colorfull" should be "colorful". (गलत वर्तनी) • **Hindi Meaning:** माली ने रंगीन फूलों को बगीचे में लगाया। • **Example:** Incorrect: The gardner planted colorfull flowers in the garden. 39:Tceb, The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Atheists**.
